biography: Born in Garmisch-Partenkirchen, Hans-Joachim 'Hans' Stuck III inherited his passion for motorsport from his legendary father, Hans-Joachim Stuck Sr. Young Hans spent his childhood immersed in the roar of engines, devouring tales of his father's triumphs. He started karting at age 10, quickly displaying a raw, aggressive talent that both thrilled and terrified his instructors. His breakthrough came at 18, winning the ADAC Northern Bavaria Kart Championship. Transitioning to formula cars, he secured a seat in the German Formula 3 series, showing flashes of brilliance despite his car’s inferior performance. This led to a test drive with Audi V8 quattro DTM team and a subsequent contract at 21. Now, at 23, he’s seen as a rising star, balancing his DTM commitments with guest appearances in GT racing, always pushing the limits.
drivingStyle: Stuck's driving style is characterized by relentless aggression and calculated risk-taking. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often pushing his car to the very edge of adhesion. While some accuse him of being overly aggressive, his supporters praise his unwavering commitment and willingness to fight for every position. He has a knack for extracting maximum performance from his car, even when it's not the fastest on the grid, and is always looking for an opportunity to gain an advantage.

rivalries.reason: A bitter rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at the Norisring in DTM, resulting in Stuck losing crucial championship points.
Intense on-track battles in GT racing, fueled by mutual respect and a fierce determination to prove who's the best.

quirks: Always wears his father's lucky racing gloves before every race.
Has to listen to a specific German punk rock song exactly 30 minutes before the race start.
Refuses to speak to anyone except his engineer for the last hour before a race.
famousQuote: You don't win races by being polite. You win them by being faster. And sometimes, you have to be a little bit… forceful.
careerHighlight: Winning the Norisring DTM race in 2023 after starting from 10th on the grid, a thrilling display of overtaking prowess in front of a home crowd.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the Hockenheimring in 2022 due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential race victory and a serious blow to his championship aspirations.
